trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: The model must be on a non-CPU device before conversion; the harness checks whether newly created parameters or buffers remain on the original device.

bug_oracle.description: Calling torch.nn.SyncBatchNorm.convert_sync_batchnorm on a CUDA-resident model containing BatchNorm layers creates new parameters on CPU instead of the original GPU device.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary model device placements and BatchNorm configurations before conversion.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct models containing BatchNorm layers and move them to a non-CPU device such as CUDA.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Assert that all parameters and buffers after conversion remain on the original device.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Move a model with BatchNorm layers to CUDA; apply torch.nn.SyncBatchNorm.convert_sync_batchnorm; inspect the device of all parameters and buffers.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare the device of every parameter and buffer before and after conversion; fail if any newly created parameter or buffer is placed on CPU.
